title: modular spaceport construction materials and stock

specimens.name: Aluminium sandwich-panel perimeter edge
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE short modern aerospace panel edge with smooth off-white aluminium face skins, a rigid solid structural core, clean replaceable extruded aluminium perimeter profile and a readable layered cut edge. No open honeycomb cells (reserved for cell 6), no foam-catalog texture, no full wall or service hatch.

specimens.name: Carbon-fibre laminate cutaway coupon
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE short rectangular carbon-fibre reinforced composite coupon, matte graphite twill face, several visibly stacked structural laminate plies at the cut end; clean aerospace-fabrication sample, not a vehicle shell or polymer trim.

specimens.name: Moulded glass-fibre service-cover corner
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE off-white glass-fibre-reinforced polymer cover CORNER fragment, shallow moulded rib, precise rounded flange and two integrated captive fastening seats; distinguish clearly from cell 1 panel-stock edge and from cell 5 extruded trim; no whole cover.

specimens.name: Powder-coated folded graphite sheet corner
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE dark-graphite powder-coated metal folded corner fragment with uniform industrial sheet thickness, single measured bend radius and broad quiet planes; not a full electronics chassis, not a bracket collection, no E2 beige rack.

specimens.name: Off-white snap-fit engineering-polymer extrusion
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE short light off-white polymer trim PROFILE with an open cut end showing distinctive interior support webs, two functional snap-fit retaining lips and a matching assembly groove; not a cover shell or another aluminium panel.

specimens.name: Honeycomb-core bonded sandwich panel coupon
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE short panel cross-section with clearly OPEN repeating hexagonal aluminium honeycomb cells between two thin bonded face sheets; unmistakable honeycomb structure, distinct from cell 1 SOLID-core panel.

specimens.name: Anodized aluminium T-slot structural profile
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE short precision extruded aluminium structural profile length, unmistakable undercut T-slot mounting geometry and clean visible end face; no full rack, no machine rail and no separate fasteners.

specimens.name: Elastomeric environmental compression edge seal
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short dark charcoal EPDM/silicone weather seal extrusion showing two independently legible flexible compression lips, hollow sealing chambers and a fixed retention foot for mating groove; no separate rubber pads or mechanical components.

global_forbidden: text, labels, letters, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing
any ninth specimen, extra fragment, repeated object class, substituted, merged or omitted specimen
whole building, room, facade, vehicle, spacecraft, radar, machinery, control panel, catalog application board or staged scene
baked cast/contact shadows, studio-product shadows, glow, bloom, rays, live display graphics or temporary FX
photorealistic PBR material-catalog rendering, rendered CAD/studio 3D look, photographic materials or filtered 3D render
generic smooth image devoid of intentional HD pixel-art clusters, missing dark chromatic selective outlines or continuous-airbrush gradients
motors, buttons, standalone connectors, lights, dashboards or any other role's standalone hardware
E2 beige rack and dense external wiring, E4 curtain-wall structures, E5 transparent holograms and levitation

era_contract.character: E3 2015 modern spaceport construction vocabulary: serviceable modular composite stock, anodized aluminium and engineered polymers, clean replaceable sections and calm off-white/graphite faces; all physically serviceable but distinctly less boxy and cluttered than E2 1998
required_signals: clear manufacturing replacement from E2 test-equipment sheet metal to modular aerospace sandwich/composite materials
separate carbon-fibre laminate, glass-fibre moulded cover, honeycomb core and solid-core sandwich edge without visual duplication
repeatably machined/extruded interfaces, clean edges and practical replaceable mounting
distinct functional elastomer seals and polymer snap-fit extrusions rather than E2 isolation pads
cohesive stylized HD pixel art governed by the complete verbatim style_bible
replaced_previous_language: E2 precision-painted steel electronic plate replaced by structural aluminium sandwich-panel edge
E2 beige-gray ABS test-equipment panel replaced by load-bearing carbon-fibre laminate coupon
E2 aluminium instrument faceplate replaced by glass-fibre moulded service-cover corner
E2 dense folded electronics chassis fragment replaced by clean single-radius graphite structural folded panel
E2 perforated ventilation sheet replaced by off-white modular snap-fit polymer trim
E2 rack mounting profile replaced by functional bonded honeycomb-core panel vocabulary
E2 nylon support block replaced by T-slot structural extrusion
E2 die-cut isolator pad replaced by continuous double-lip environmental seal
forbidden_regressions: beige CRT/rack laboratory look or bulky 1998 control-cabinet pieces
generic thin painted steel plate, single rib plastic faceplate, ventilated coupon or loose neoprene rectangle standing in for the E3 specimens
photorealistic product-catalog imagery instead of the style bible
cleaner E2 by recolor alone without composite/modular physical replacements
